menu.label: App menu
table.emptyDescription: Whatever you add shows up here.
table.noMatchDescription: Try fewer words or another filter.
dictation.localDetail: Works offline once the voice download is ready.
dictation.localPrivacy: Your recording stays on this Mac. No AI credits needed.
dictation.onlinePrivacy: Your recording goes to Tellop’s AI service. Your chosen text field stays private.
dictation.readOnly: You can see these preferences, but you cannot change them.
dictation.how: Press the floating microphone to start, then Stop to insert your words. Cancel discards the recording.
dictation.copyHelp: If the field cannot receive your words, use Copy in the floating control.
dictation.unavailable: Open this app in Tellop on your Mac.
dictation.unsupported: Dictation is not supported on this Mac.
dictation.permission: Open Tellop to allow dictation and check microphone access.
dictation.not-ready: The voice download is not ready. Open Tellop to check its progress.
dictation.busy: Dictation is busy. Finish the current recording, then try again.
dictation.failed: Dictation could not complete this action. Try again.
dictation.invalidPreferences: Choose a speaking language and how to write down your speech.
dictation.hidden: The microphone is hidden. Show it when you are ready.
dictation.ready: Choose a text field, then press Record in the floating control.
dictation.recording: The microphone is recording. Use Stop or Cancel in the floating control.
dictation.transcribing: Your speech is being written down.
dictation.transcript: Your words are available to copy in the floating control.
dictation.readiness.ready: The voice download is ready for offline dictation.
dictation.readiness.absent: The voice download is not ready. Open Tellop to prepare it.
dictation.readiness.downloading: Tellop is downloading the voice files.
dictation.readiness.no-room: The voice download needs more free space on this Mac.
dictation.readiness.failed: The voice download failed. Open Tellop to try again.
dictation.readiness.incompatible: Offline dictation is not supported on this Mac.
dictation.permissionsHelp: Recording needs microphone access. Allow Accessibility in macOS settings before recording to insert your words.
dictation.clipboardHelp: For some apps, Tellop briefly uses your clipboard to paste your words. After confirmed insertion, it restores what you copied if the clipboard has not changed. If insertion cannot be confirmed, it clears its temporary clipboard value and cannot restore the previous contents.
dictation.setupDetail: Allow text insertion before your first recording.
dictation.readyDetail: Show the microphone, then choose where your words go.
dictation.accessibilityDetail: Lets Tellop insert your words into the field you choose.
dictation.settingsNote: Allow Tellop in macOS settings. If it is missing, use + to add Tellop. Return here to check again.
dictation.microphoneNote: Microphone access is checked when you press Record. Nothing records during setup.
dictation.accessibility: Accessibility access is needed. Open settings, then check again.
dictation.offlineSetupDetail: Show the microphone to download or retry the offline voice files.
